root_cause: 2D verify_corpus used permissive json.loads for manifest and JSONL. Python silently accepts duplicate object keys (last wins) and NaN/Infinity; rehashed files could pass SOURCE integrity despite ambiguous receipt/row semantics. 2A hardened native receipt JSON independently but FORGE importer still accepted ambiguous JSON.
fix: Use strict object_pairs_hook and parse_constant for original 2D manifest and all rows; reject duplicate nested role/content, duplicate manifest keys, and nonfinite values before approval; preserve legacy two-split and owner threeway contracts.
lesson: Training import integrity requires canonical unambiguous JSON parsing before even source-level SHA/row provenance gates; duplicated keys with matching effective values must never count as a clean approval.
next_step: Verify exact source CI, then owner-authenticated read-only STOP, one-writer lease, HF base/TRL, checkpoint25 optimizer/scaler/RNG and independent offsite restore; only after gates perform held-out RU/ES/code/Genesis and bounded optimizer resume.
